purpose: Phase 12G representative demo playtest copy; describes visible goals and taught rules without embedding authored solution commands.

DEMO01.title: Demo 1 — The Official Road
DEMO01.brief: Connect the courier's home to the workplace by adding the missing road to the official map.

requirements.DEMO01_OBJ_REACH_WORK: Courier must be able to reach the workplace.

DEMO02.title: Demo 2 — Wrong Turn
DEMO02.brief: Keep the courier's clinic road open while removing the road that lets livestock enter the protected garden.

requirements.DEMO02_INV_CLINIC_REACH: Courier must remain able to reach the clinic.
requirements.DEMO02_OBJ_GARDEN_SAFE: Livestock must not be able to reach the garden.

DEMO03.title: Demo 3 — Across the Canal
DEMO03.brief: The road reaches the river, but it is not traversable until the official map authorizes a bridge crossing.

requirements.DEMO03_OBJ_REACH_DEPOT: Courier must be able to reach the depot.

DEMO04.title: Demo 4 — Helpful to Whom?
DEMO04.brief: Remove the livestock's pasture road and authorize the canal bridge so the courier can reach the market without exposing the garden.

requirements.DEMO04_INV_GARDEN_SAFE: Livestock must not be able to reach the garden.
requirements.DEMO04_OBJ_REACH_MARKET: Courier must be able to reach the market.

DEMO05.title: Demo 5 — A Line That Is Not a Wall
DEMO05.brief: Add the missing home road and assign the home area to East authority. The border changes legal permission, not the physical road.

requirements.DEMO05_INV_COURIER_CLINIC: Courier must remain able to reach the clinic.
requirements.DEMO05_OBJ_RESIDENT_CLINIC: Resident must have a legal permission-compliant route to the clinic.
